datasets.name: SALT-NLP Sketch2Code
datasets.notes: The upstream code is MIT, but the dataset inherits Design2Code data terms; do not treat the code license as a data license. Design2Code states research-only terms and ODC-By provenance from C4. Excluded from training pending rights review.
